meta.mode: Read-only Figma use_figma calls; no design mutations
meta.sourceOfEvidence: Actual component and showcase-instance subtrees fetched from Figma, not local renderer output or coverage counts
meta.snapshotCaveat: Any later mutation to a cited component, inherited base component, or instance requires targeted revalidation.
meta.postFixRevalidation: Seven affected canonical components and their showcase instances were fetched again after edits; all requested checks passed. Final delivery-scene instance was corrected separately.

method: Resolved all 175 returned component IDs and all 175 showcase instance IDs against the actual Figma file.
Read visible text, panel headers, status labels and status master variants, action labels and button style variants, form fields/options and selected/disabled presentation.
Matched expected steps/checks/child agents/progress, authorization scope, resource/file/model identity and recovery text against actual node values.
Asserted terminal approval cases have no active reverse decision buttons and locked cases have only disabled rendered button variants.
Compared actual component and showcase visible text sequences; no divergence was found.
Read eight rich-output/form panels separately; verified actual generated-file status and playback state/icons/timestamps remain distinct.
Only returned bounded per-case differences and node evidence; use_figma calls were strictly sequential.
